project: Dr Plant full multicrop training v2
limitations: Full dataset images used; not a random small subset.
Training used CPU, 128px images, and fine-tuned final two MobileNet feature blocks initialized from v1.
PlantVillage-style image holdout is not field validation; results may not transfer to phone photos or Syrian farms.
Expert label review and near-duplicate review are still needed.
Review dataset licensing before commercial distribution.
